summary: Rick Deckard wakes up and discusses with his wife Iran about the mood organ and their fake electric sheep. He goes to work and encounters a situation about owning real vs. artificial animals. Dave Holden, the senior bounty hunter, is shot and hospitalized.
key_events: Rick wakes up using mood organ
Argument with wife Iran about artificial sheep
Rick worries about owning a fake animal
Dave Holden is shot and hospitalized
narrative_observations: Chapter 1 focuses on: Authenticity vs. simulation; Empathy and emotion
Central characters: Rick Deckard, Iran (Rick's wife), Bill Barbour (neighbor)
Philosophical weight: Explores Consciousness and awareness
